# Garlic LLM source retained by MATRIX

This directory contains Android-adapted source files derived from Garlic LLM by Leonardo Alegría.

Upstream: https://github.com/leonardo-alegria/garlic-llm

The upstream application code is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later. The complete upstream licence is included in this directory. The source modifications in MATRIX are documented alongside each adapted shader and in `app/src/main/cpp/garlic/PORTING_NOTES.md`.

The Qwen model weights and any other third-party assets retain their separate terms. They are not bundled by copying the Garlic model files blindly.
